- [NDBG.17.2] **Firings as threads** ([NDBG.10.1.1]). Each firing the
  session shows is a DAP thread. Those other than the focused one use
  `subtle` stack frames pointing to the rule declaration. `RuleDebugName`
  atoms (RDSC.6.8) supply human-readable display names so the thread panel
  is legible without numeric IDs.
